question: Which is the lengthiest written Constitution in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Constitution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Indian Constitution** is the lengthiest written Constitution in the world, with 395 articles, 12 schedules, and 22 parts at the time of its adoption in 1950.
 
• It underwent several amendments, and as of 2023, it includes **470 articles, 12 schedules, and 25 parts**, covering an extensive range of topics.
 
• The drafting of the Indian Constitution was led by the **Constituent Assembly**, chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, and it took nearly **2 years, 11 months, and 18 days** to complete.
 
• The Indian Constitution draws inspiration from various global constitutions but has been uniquely tailored to the socio-economic and political needs of India.
 
• It establishes India as a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**, emphasizing justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity for its citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly:**

 
 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was established in 1946 to draft the Indian Constitution.
 
• It included representatives from various provinces and princely states, ensuring diverse participation.
 
• The assembly had 299 members at the time of adoption.
 
 
 
• **Borrowed Features:**
 
 
• The Indian Constitution adopted ideas from the constitutions of countries like the USA (fundamental rights), UK (parliamentary system), Ireland (directive principles of state policy), and Canada (federal structure).
 
 
 
• **Amendments:**
 
 
• The Indian Constitution is a living document and has been amended **105 times** as of 2023 to address changing needs.
 
• The first amendment was enacted in 1951, addressing land reforms and other socio-economic issues.
 
 
 
• **Length and Complexity:**
 
 
• The Indian Constitution is detailed and comprehensive to address India's diversity and complexities in culture, language, and governance.
 
• It includes provisions for fundamental rights, directive principles, union-state relations, emergency powers, and more.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• In contrast, the US Constitution is among the shortest written constitutions with only 7 articles and 27 amendments.
 
• The British Constitution is unwritten and consists of statutes, conventions, and legal documents.
